title: 🍺 Feldschlösschen Detective
description: Aargau is known for one of the most famous beers in Switzerland.
instructions: Find three different Feldschlösschen products. Without looking at labels, one teammate must correctly all three flavours of the Feldschlösschen beers. The beers must be correctly matched to their labels after the guesses.(Blind taste Test) If you fail, you can try again after waiting 10 minutes

title: Appenzeller Cheese Whiz
description: Appenzell is known for its famous swiss cheese company,
instructions:
Find three different cheeses that are officially branded as Appenzeller cheese.
Before checking the label details, the team must correctly predict which cheese is which based only on appearance, smell, or tasting.
Possible examples include different ages or varieties of Appenzeller cheese.
Rules
The team must identify three different Appenzeller-branded cheeses.
The cheeses must be correctly matched to their labels after the guesses.(Blindtaste Test) If you fail, you can try again after waiting 10 minutes

title: Appenzell Architecture Tour
description: Find three different traditional Appenzell houses or buildings with visible decorative artwork or painted details.
instructions:
For each building:
Take a photo showing the decorative feature.
Identify what type of feature you found (for example: painted façade, carved wooden detail, traditional sign, window decoration, or other Appenzell-style ornament).
Explain briefly why you think it represents traditional Appenzell architecture.
Rules
The three buildings must be at least 250 metres apart from each other.
The same building cannot be used more than once.
The decorative feature must be a permanent part of the building, not a temporary poster, advertisement, or decoration.
For each house:  
* Name your favorite detail.  
* Guess what the artwork represents.  
* Check if you can find information about its meaning.  
Complete the challenge by finding three different decorated houses

title: Bear Imitator
description: Bern is famous for its bears. Your mission is to discover the bears hiding throughout the canton.
instructions:
Find bears from three different locations in the canton of Bern.
For each bear:
Take a photo showing the bear symbol, statue, artwork, or other representation.
Identify where the bear was found.
Create a different bear pose or imitation inspired by each bear.
The three bears must come from different towns, villages, or cities within the canton.  You cannot use the same symbol more than 1 time.

title: Fossil Hunter
description: Basel Land is full of old Swiss fossils. Find a public geological information sign somewhere in Basel-Landschaft.
instructions:
Find a public geological information sign somewhere in Basel-Landschaft.
The sign must contain information about the geology, rocks, landscape formation, fossils, or natural history of the area.
Once you find the sign:
Take a photo of the sign.
Identify one interesting geological fact from the information.
Explain what type of geological feature or process the sign describes.
Rules
The team may not use Google or online searches to locate a geological information sign.
The sign must be discovered during normal travel through Basel-Landschaft.
The sign must be publicly accessible.

title: Bonjour! Grüzi! Guten tag!
description: Basel sits at the meeting point of Switzerland, Germany, and France. Explore Basel's unique border culture through its languages.
instructions:
Take a phot of three examples of greetings used in the Basel area:
One greeting in Swiss German.
One greeting in French.
One greeting in standard German.
The greetings can be found on public signs, advertisements, menus, shop displays, transport information, or other public sources.
Each of the sources cannot be located within 250m of each other. 
Photos must clearly show the language being used.

title: Time Traveler
description: Fribourg combines medieval history with modern life. Find clues that show how the city has changed over time.
instructions: Find three objects/buildings/features that existed in medieval Fribourg, judged by ChatGPT to be at least over 500 years old.  And then, one modern object that is judged by ChatGPT to be less than 1 year old (note, this cannot be any perishable or edible, it must be a "permanent" object).

title: Geneva Peace Summit
description: Geneva is one of the world's most important centers for international diplomacy, peace, and global cooperation.
instructions:
Complete a Geneva international relations trivia challenge.
The Game Master will generate three age-appropriate questions about Geneva's role in world affairs using the following prompt:
Create three multiple choice (A-D) trivia questions suitable for a knowledgeable 12-year-old about Geneva's role in international relations. Questions may relate to the United Nations, international organizations, diplomacy, peace agreements, humanitarian work, or major historical events connected to Geneva. Questions should require knowledge and reasoning but not specialist expertise.

The team must answer all three questions correctly. If you do not answer all three correctly, you must wait at least 15 minutes before trying again.

title: The Green Cheese Roll
description: Glarus is home to Schabziger, one of Switzerland's most distinctive cheeses. Your mission is to prove your cheese skills with a rolling challenge inspired by the famous cheese games of the world.
instructions:
Find a piece of Schabziger or another suitable cheese product from Glarus. The cheese cannot cost more than 10 CHF total.
Create a cheese rolling course using a safe, publicly accessible area with a slight slope.
The team must:
Place the cheese at the starting point.
Roll the cheese down the course. The cheese must roll at least 5m down the hill before stopping. If it does not roll 10m, you must wait 10 minutes before attempting again.

title: Rätoromanisch Translator
description: Graubünden is Switzerland’s most linguistically diverse canton and home to Rätoromanisch, one of Switzerland’s national languages. Explore the language hidden in the landscape.

title: Freiberger Horse Creator
description: The Franches-Montagnes horse is one of Switzerland’s most famous horse breeds and is strongly connected to Jura. Create your own perfect Freiberger horse.
instructions:
Design your own Freiberger horse profile.
Your team must decide:
1) The horse’s name.
2) Its personality.
3) Its special ability.
4) Its ideal job.
5) Its weakness or funny flaw.
The profile must include at least three real characteristics of the Freiberger breed.
Draw a picture of your horse and make a video (at least 30 seconds long) that presents your horse's profile and send it to the other team. You cannot do any research or preparations for this task until you are in canton Jura.

title: Lucerne Postcard Challenge
description: Lucerne is famous for its combination of lake, mountains, and iconic Swiss scenery. Create the perfect Lucerne postcard.

title: Watch Factory Manager
description: Neuchâtel is part of Switzerland’s historic watchmaking region. You must become one with the watch
instructions: One team mate claps their hand.  The second team mate must clap their hands as close to 15 seconds after the other team member.  Using a timer, the claps must be within 14.5 seconds to 15.5 seconds of each other.    If you fail, you must wait at least 10 minutes before reattempting

title: Champion's Podium
description: Nidwalden is home to one of Switzerland's greatest skiers, Marco Odermatt.  Create your own championship ceremony wherever you are.
instructions:
Create your own medal ceremony.
Find three objects that can represent medal winners.
Assign:Gold medal
Silver medal
Bronze medal

The objects must match the correct medal colours:
Gold = first place
Silver = second place
Bronze = third place
Each object must have a reason why it deserves its medal.
The challenge is complete when the team can explain:
why each object received its medal;
why the gold medal winner is better than the silver and bronze winners.

title: Lake Sarnen Animal Lover
description: Lake Sarnen is home to many animals. Explore the area around the lake and discover the wildlife connected to Obwalden.
instructions:
Find and photograph five different animals around Lake Sarnen.
The animals can include:
birds;
insects;
mammals;
other visible wildlife.
Rules:
The animals must be real animals, not pictures, statues, signs, or decorations.
Each animal must be different.
The animals must be found within 10m of the lake (or on the lake of course).
Complete the challenge by showing five different animal photos.

title: St. Gallen Thing Knower
description: St. Gallen has a unique history shaped by its abbey, textiles, and traditions. Test your knowledge of the canton with a local trivia challenge.
instructions:
Travel to a location in St. Gallen and complete a St. Gallen trivia challenge.
Ask ChatGPT to generate three questions using the following prompt:
"Create three multiple choice (A-D) trivia questions about the canton of St. Gallen suitable for a family game. Questions should cover local history, geography, culture, famous people, traditions, landmarks, or unique facts about St. Gallen. The questions should be challenging but solvable by a knowledgeable 12-year-old."
The team must answer all three questions correctly.
If an answer is incorrect, the team must 15 minutes before trying again.

title: Munot Messenger
description: The Munot Fortress has watched over Schaffhausen for centuries. Send a secret message like a medieval messenger using only symbols.
instructions:
Create a message that your teammate must decode. One team member creates a message using only emojis. The message must contain at least five emojis, and must form a complete sentence including a noun and a verb.
The other team member must guess the exact sentence.
The message should represent a warning, announcement, or instruction that could have been sent from the Munot Fortress.
If the guess is incorrect the team must wait 15 minutes before trying again.  You cannot coordinate at all beforehand.

title: The Rule of 11
description: Solothurn has a famous connection to the number 11. Explore the city and find examples where the number appears.

title: Morgarten History Reenactment
description: Schwyz played a central role in the early history of Switzerland. Travel to the site of the Battle of Morgarten and recreate a moment from Swiss history.

title: Apple of my eye
description: Thurgau is known as the "apple canton" of Switzerland. Explore its most famous fruit through an observation challenge.

title: Ticino Translation Challenge
description: Ticino is Switzerland’s Italian-speaking canton. Test your language skills by translating an Italian sentence across three more languages.
instructions:
Complete an Italian translation challenge.
Use the following prompt in ChatGPT to generate one Italian sentence:
"Create one medium-difficulty sentence in Italian. The sentence should be suitable for a family language challenge and should include enough vocabulary and grammar to require real translation, but should not use rare words or complex grammar."
The team must correctly translate the sentence into:
English
German
French
The team must then put their suggestions back into ChatGPT for confimration. You cannot use any other language tools.  If all three are not judged as being correct translations, you must wait 10 minutes before trying again.

title: Birthplace of Switzerland
description: Uri is connected to the founding story of Switzerland. Travel to one of the country's most famous historical locations.
instructions:
Travel to the Rütli Meadow.
At the location take a photo recreating the legendary oath of the Swiss Confederates.

title: Olympic Challenge
description: Lausanne is home to the International Olympic Committee and is known as the Olympic Capital. Test your Olympic knowledge in the city where the modern Olympic movement is managed.
instructions:
Travel to the International Olympic Committee headquarters or Olympic Museum area in Lausanne.
Complete an Olympic trivia challenge. Ask ChatGPT to  generate five questions using the following prompt:
"Create five family-friendly multiple choice (A-D) trivia questions about the Olympic Games, suitable for a 12-year-old. Questions should include Olympic history, famous athletes, host cities, symbols, traditions, or facts connected to the International Olympic Committee. At least two questions should relate specifically to Lausanne or the IOC."
The team must answer all five questions correctly. If not all five are correctly answered, you must wait 10 minutes before trying again. You cannot search or use any other tools to answer the questions.

title: Matterhorn Expedition
description: Valais is home to Switzerland's most famous mountain: the Matterhorn. Reach one of the most iconic viewpoints in Switzerland.

title: Cherry I Love you Baby
description: Zug is famous for its cherries and the iconic Zuger Kirschtorte.
instructions:
Buy a box of cherries (at least 200g).
Before counting, predict how many cherries are in the box. You may not research anything related to cherry weight calculations beforehand.
Count the actual number of cherries. Your prediction must be within 15% of the actual number of cherries in the box. If you fail, you need to buy a new box and try again.  If you are correct and have predictred within 15% of the total number of cherries, you can complete the challenge by eating the whole box of cherries.

title: Zürich Transit Master
description: Canton Zürich has one of Switzerland’s most extensive public transport networks. Master the canton's many forms of transportation.
instructions:
Complete a Zürich public transport challenge.
The team must travel on four different types of public transport within the canton of Zürich.
Possible transport types include:
1) Tram
2) Bus
3) Boat
4) Cog railway
5) Funicular
6) Cable car
For each transport type you must:
Travel at least 500 metres.
Take a photo showing the transport type or vehicle.
The challenge is complete when the team has successfully used four different transport types.
